  "per_column": [

      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Binary theme flag with interpretable categories; directly captures a review theme that can be segmented and compared across sentiment. Core to the query about differing themes."
    },
    {
      "name": "mentions_food_quality",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Clear binary theme indicator with well-separated 0/1 groups; enables comparison of food-quality mentions between positive and negative reviews."
    },
    {
      "name": "mentions_wait_time",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable theme flag; wait-time mentions are a meaningful associational variable to cross-tabulate against sentiment."
    },
    {
      "name": "mentions_price",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Binary price-theme indicator, well-separated categories, directly supports theme-vs-sentiment exploration."
    },
    {
      "name": "mentions_cleanliness",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable theme flag; somewhat rare (19 positives) but still yields a meaningful comparison across sentiment."
    },
    {
      "name": "mentions_atmosphere",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Binary atmosphere-theme indicator with clear categories; supports segmentation against the focus."
    },
    {
      "name": "exclamation_count",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Stylistic count with an interpretable scale that can be bucketed; associational with sentiment intensity, though more mechanical and not a 'theme' per se. Weakly informative for the theme-focused query."
    },
    {
      "name": "positive_words_count",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "Lexicon-based positive word count is essentially a proxy of the sentiment label itself; it restates the focus rather than opening an external relationship, and reveals little about differing themes."
    },
    {
      "name": "negative_words_count",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "Negative-lexicon count closely mirrors the sentiment label; largely restates the focus and is not an external thematic dimension."
    }
  ],
  "n_predictors": 7,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.72,
  "rationale": "The six 'mentions_*' theme flags are exactly the kind of interpretable, well-separated segmentation variables the query needs: they let an explorer cross-tabulate distinct review themes (service, food, wait, price, cleanliness, atmosphere) against positive/negative sentiment. These squarely satisfy the exploratory claim. exclamation_count adds a mildly informative but mechanical stylistic dimension. The two lexicon word-count columns largely restate the sentiment label and are near-duplicative of the focus, weakening the set. Overall the theme flags carry strong, interpretable relationship value, so the set scores well but is dragged down by the restatement columns."
}
